fields.label: Default Reservation Validity Days
fields.description: Default number of days a new reservation remains valid when no end date is provided.

fields.label: Auto Release Expired Reservations
fields.description: Allow the daily expiry utility to expire overdue reservations and release units when safe.

fields.label: Allow Reservation For Reserved Units
fields.description: When disabled, a unit with an active reservation cannot be reserved again.

fields.label: Require Customer Or Lead
fields.description: Require Customer, Lead, or Party Name before reserving a unit.

fields.label: Require Reservation Amount
fields.description: Require a positive reservation amount. No accounting entry is created.

fields.label: Warning Days Before Expiry
fields.description: Number of days used by expiring reservation reports and alerts.

fields.label: Reservation Number Prefix
fields.description: Prefix used when generating reservation numbers.

name: Unit Reservation Settings
description: Controls real estate unit reservation behavior, validity, duplicate reservation rules, and release handling.
